description: No live trading or real orders.
No broker API connections or credentials.
No investment recommendations or financial advice.
Quality and drift metrics must never be treated as trading signals.
No long/short or directional assertions derived from drift.
No strategy rule generation, backtesting, optimizer, or model training.
No target, label, forecast, or future return columns.
No automated imputation or overwriting of missing/infinite values.
No automated dropping of columns or features upon drift/quality defect.
No in-place destructive mutation or overwrite of raw data files.
No raw article bodies, scraped HTML, or copyrighted text.
No web scraping, hidden API bypass, or browser automation.
No production approval, sign-off, or deployment readiness claims.
Run strictly local, offline, read-only quality diagnostics.
Detect missingness, inf, all-NaN, zero variance, and duplicates.
Compute baseline vs current distribution shifts non-destructively.
Track rolling statistics without generating trading recommendations.
Audit input availability across all 10 factor families.
Route diagnostic defects to human analyst queue instead of auto-fixing.
Generate immutable metadata and manifests for Phase 124 Feature Store integration.
